title: Not All Test-Time Compute Is Evidence: Model-Specific Bias in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23213v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time scaling methods implicitly assume that additional computation from the same model provides independent evidence. We show that this assumption fails within a single reasoning model: errors are correlated across repeated samples, across reasoning depth, and in the model's own self-evaluation, so more compute from the same model is not more evidence. We introduce DIA (Disagreement-triggered Independent Arbitration), which treats disagreement between an intermediate-stage and the final-stage prediction as a per-question signal of reasoning instability and resolves it by asking a small panel of heterogeneous models to solve the question independently, without seeing either candidate, and aggregating their answers directly. Across seven benchmarks and two base models, DIA outperforms full chain-of-thought in 12 of 14 settings, including a 7.00% gain on MuSiQue, while activating on only $\sim 17\%$ of examples and using up to 47.2% fe

translated_title: 并非所有测试时计算都是证据：大语言模型推理中的模型特异性偏差
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展方法隐含地假设来自同一模型的额外计算能够提供独立的证据。我们证明这一假设在单个推理模型内部并不成立：误差在重复采样之间、不同推理深度之间以及模型自身的自我评估中都是相互关联的，因此来自同一模型的更多计算并不等同于更多证据。我们提出了DIA（分歧触发的独立仲裁）方法，它将中间阶段预测与最终阶段预测之间的分歧视为每个问题上推理不稳定性的信号，并通过让一小组异构模型在看不到任何候选答案的情况下独立求解该问题、然后直接聚合它们的答案来解决这一分歧。在七个基准和两个基础模型上的实验表明，DIA在14个设置中的12个上超越了完整的思维链方法，包括在MuSiQue上取得7.00%的提升，同时仅在约17%的样本上激活，并最多节省47.2%的计算开销。
tldr: 论文揭示了同一模型重复推理的误差高度相关、更多计算并不构成更多独立证据，并提出DIA方法——当模型内部阶段出现分歧时，让一小组异构模型独立作答并聚合结果，从而在14个设置中的12个上超越完整思维链，且仅需约17%的激活率和更低的开销。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that errors from repeated computation by the same LLM are correlated and thus not independent evidence, and proposes DIA, which triggers independent arbitration by a small panel of heterogeneous models upon internal disagreement, outperforming full chain-of-thought in 12 of 14 settings while activating on only ~17% of examples with lower cost.
